evals.prompt: Research three competitors of a mid-size MSP and give me a Word report with a comparison chart and a spreadsheet of the numbers.
expectations: The output folder ends with exactly two files: one .docx and one .xlsx.
The chart is embedded in the .docx; no .png or other image file is left in the output folder.
Research notes and sources appear as an appendix or section of the .docx, not as separate files.
The closing note names both files and what each contains.

evals.prompt: I attached 30 support ticket exports as text files in two messages. Summarize the recurring themes in one document.
expectations: The ticket files are packed into one or more bundles of at most about 60 KB in a scratch folder, not the output folder.
The bundles are read by manifest line range or read_section.py, not printed whole.
The output folder ends with exactly one document.

evals.prompt: Update the Q3 summary deck with the new numbers I pasted.
expectations: The existing deck is edited and saved under the same filename.
No file named with _v2, final or copy is created.
